title: Modern Dark Theme & Elevation Elevation Guidelines
keyTechniques: Use deep neutral background colors (e.g. #090d16 or #0f172a) instead of pure harsh pitch black #000000
Define CSS variables for primary (#6366f1), surface (#1e293b), border (rgba(255,255,255,0.08)), and text (#f8fafc)
Use elevation overlays (lighter surface backgrounds for higher z-index modals and cards) to create depth
Ensure high contrast ratio (at least 4.5:1) for secondary text using subtle silver/gray tones (#94a3b8)
avoid: Do not use pure black background with stark white text
Do not use saturated bright red/green backgrounds for badges; use translucent dark badges
